content.text: A commission usually starts with a size and a colour mood rather than a finished design, and that is by design. The studio's own process is to build a small sample pour in the requested palette before committing to the full piece, because a colour that reads calm on a phone screen can read cold in a living room with north-facing light. Two rounds of reference photos are standard before a final pour begins, and reference photos of the actual room the piece will sit in are worth more than a Pinterest board full of other people's resin work.
This landing page is a Content Lab fixture — placeholder editorial content demonstrating the block catalogue, not a live campaign.
